## Status

## Summary

Исправить A5 отдельной bounded download job/selector: временно не скачанный `Discovered` автоматически повторяется после `next_retry_at`, а future detail backoff блокирует все OR-trigger ветви. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/artifacts-PARSING_PRODUCTION_ACCEPTANCE.json:161-181`).

## Why

Downloader доступен только из detail flow; Bidding/Completed без новой revision может больше не попасть туда, а текущий selector обходит future retry через соседние OR. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/artifacts-PARSING_PRODUCTION_AUDIT.json`, A5).

## Rules

- Retry owner ровно один: command/reconciler atomically claims due rows and dispatches unique job; detail path may perform first attempt but must not compete after failure. Removed/permanently failed/future rows are excluded. Backoff is a top-level AND over all detail trigger reasons. Job calls the same Downloader and is idempotent under duplicate delivery. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/research-01-remediation-architecture.json`).

## Guidance

Negative sequence: Bidding procurement + two documents, one HTTP 500 and one success; no new revision; advance to due; real dispatched job downloads failed document once. Assert future retry blocks `detail_fetched_at null` and `new revision` branches. Do not call only job `handle()` for the dispatch assertion: use Queue fake for selection plus direct job behavior separately. Do not add both queue retries and domain retry ownership.
